title: ARI-RQGM UtilityRecord
description: One governed-utility audit record (docs/reference/rqgm_schemas.md, "rqgm_utility_record.schema.json" under "Adversarial-loop schemas (Task 06)"; schema owned by Task 06; the adversarial penalty channel is its sole v1 emitter). Kernel check 4 / invariant 8: a record with penalty > 0 must reference >= 1 ValidatedAttackRecord in input_refs.validated_attack_ids — raw attacks never score. input_refs and frozen_policy are stored by value so Task 10's recompute under the original epoch's weights needs no registry lookup; supersedes / recomputed_in_epoch are reserved nullable Task 10 fields. prompt_hash carries utility_policy_hash, which is REGISTRY-BACKED since Task 14 (docs/reference/rqgm_schemas.md, "Governed utility-evolution schema (Task 14)"; docs/concepts/rqgm_architecture.md, "Governed utility evolution"): it is the registered prompt_hash of the active utility_policy registry entry — i.e. the EPOCH policy {composite, axis_weights, frontier_score, depth_penalty_lambda, ucb_c} frozen at the boundary — which is what makes a governed score rewrite able to invalidate the scores its retired policy produced (the retirement->repair join is prompt-keyed). VERSION BOUNDARY: records written BEFORE Task 14 carry the disjoint PENALTY policy's hash ({penalty_cap, severity_weights, verdict_factors}) in this field instead, and a frozen_policy with only the three penalty keys; they remain valid, recompute correctly (MetricRecomputer reads only those three), and simply never match a utility_policy retirement — exactly their pre-14 behavior. Task-14 records additionally carry the epoch policy BY VALUE under frozen_policy.utility_policy, so a record is self-describing without a registry lookup. created_at is wall-clock metadata, never hashed (P2). Additive-only evolution.

frozen_policy.description: The by-value frozen weights. The three penalty keys are required and unchanged, so every record ever written still validates. `utility_policy` is the additive sub-object described in docs/reference/rqgm_schemas.md, "rqgm_utility_record.schema.json": the EPOCH policy by value, so the record carries both policies and needs no registry lookup to be read after a rewrite. Optional: records written before governed utility evolution landed do not have it.
